rating.verdict: A synergy-heavy Borg artifact deck that rewards planning combat and sacrifice timing, which is why it's an intermediate pick. It has no Game Changers or two-card combos, so it fits Bracket 2 (Core), toward the top of that bracket thanks to Skullclamp and one-sided wipes.
strengths: Every connecting artifact creature makes another drone with Locutus out
Battle of Wolf 359 and Join the Collective clear the table while your drones survive
Skullclamp and the Co-Option Adjutant / Hive Mind Coprocessor draw engine refill your hand
weaknesses: Artifact removal and sweepers like Vandalblast hurt badly
Tokens are 1/1s: needs anthems or evasion to connect
Three colors mean the odd awkward mana draw

wins: Get artifact creatures through for combat damage: with Locutus out, each one that connects makes a new 1/1 Borg drone. Grow the Collective with Tempered Steel, Locutus, the One Who Speaks and Assault Drone, then give it evasion with One, Borg Evolved or Organic Avulsion Unit.
plan: Cheap drones (Assembly Specialist, Tenacious Drone, Vexing Drone) and mana rocks. Skullclamp early is a great start.
Cast Locutus of Borg. Attack with anything that can get through; each hit makes another drone.

Add combat-damage rewards (Co-Option Adjutant draws, Supplementation Node grows) and an evasion piece. Use Battle of Wolf 359 when opponents' boards are bigger than yours: it kills their nonartifact creatures, not yours.
One, Borg Evolved or Primary Unimatrix Adjunct turns the swarm into double strikers. Swing wide and assimilate the table.
keys: Lifelink, and every artifact creature you control makes a Borg drone when it deals combat damage to a player.
Gives all your artifact creatures flying, double strike, vigilance, menace, lifelink and ward 2.
All nonartifact creatures get -X/-X, where X is your artifact creature count: a one-sided wipe.
Replicate on every artifact spell: copy drones for 2U each.
Equip a 1/1 drone: it dies and you draw two cards.
tips: Every Borg in this deck is an artifact creature, so they all get Locutus's ability and your anthems.
Join the Collective destroys all creatures, then gives you a drone for each nonartifact creature destroyed. Your artifact creatures die too, so cast it when you're behind.
Reclamation Specialist and Automated Warfare System turn spare drones into cards.
Hold Counterspell or Swan Song for the board wipe aimed at your artifacts.
mulligan: Keep 3 lands (ideally two colors) plus a mana rock or two cheap drones. Skullclamp in the opening hand is a keep.
